title: Xu Haidong, ranked 428th, beats Thibault Poret as Roanne end SPO Rouen's unbeaten Pro A start
seo_title: Pro A: Roanne end Rouen's unbeaten start
description: Xu Haidong beat world No 22 Thibault Poret as Roanne won 3-1 against SPO Rouen, and Nîmes/Montpellier beat Hennebont 3-2 without the Lebrun brothers in Pro A.
standfirst: Rouen stay top of the French men's Pro A after the sixth matchday, a point clear, but Hennebont also lost, beaten 3-2 by an Alliance Nîmes/Montpellier side without Félix and Alexis Lebrun.
body: Xu Haidong, ranked 428th in the world and rarely picked by Loire Nord TT this season, beat the world No 22 Thibault Poret and then Alexandre Robinot as Roanne won 3-1 to end SPO Rouen's unbeaten start in the French men's Pro A on Sunday.

Rouen, the champions, had won their first five matches. They stay top on 21 points, one ahead of GV Hennebont and Roanne, after a sixth matchday in which Hennebont also lost: Alliance Nîmes/Montpellier beat them 3-2 without Félix and Alexis Lebrun.

Xu opened against Poret and won in four games. Poret, two games to one down, had two game points in the fourth to force a decider, but Xu saved both and closed it out. Xu has 25 world ranking points to Poret's 1,865, and Rouen's own report noted that Roanne had used him little this season.

Robinot levelled with a straight-games win over Slovakia's Wang Yang, the world No 92 and a defender, and Rouen were level at 1-1 at the break. Esteban Dorr, who had lost the mixed doubles final at WTT Star Contender Muscat the day before, then led Sweden's Elias Ranefur 9-1 in the third game, only for Ranefur to win the next nine points and the game. The world No 26 won the fourth to put Roanne 2-1 up.

Robinot, unbeaten in Pro A this season until then, took the first game of the fourth match against Xu. Xu won the next three to seal the tie and his second win of the afternoon. Rouen called it a setback without consequences, since they stay top.

Nîmes/Montpellier, sixth before the weekend with one win from five, were missing both Lebrun brothers, Manav Thakkar and Remi Betelu. Hennebont were without Simon Gauzy. The coach, Vincent Avril, told Midi Libre that Thakkar had not got back and that Betelu was injured. Thakkar had played in the men's doubles final at WTT Star Contender Muscat on Saturday.

Antoine Hachard gave the home side the lead by beating Lev Katsman 11-3, 11-2, 11-5. Vladimir Sidorenko, the world No 17, beat Grégoire Jean 7-11, 11-6, 11-5, 4-11, 11-6, and Felipe Arado then beat the 44-year-old Xin Wang 14-12, 11-8, 11-8. Sidorenko levelled again by beating Hachard 11-8, 14-16, 11-6, 11-7, before Jean beat Katsman 11-6, 11-8, 11-8 in the deciding match.

"It wasn't easy against one of the best teams in the league. We had a much weakened team without the Lebrun brothers, Manav Thakkar and Remi Betelu. Everyone brought back their point, I love that," Avril said (translated from French).
The two clubs have met in the biggest matches of recent French seasons: Nîmes/Montpellier beat Hennebont in the June 2025 final, and Hennebont won both legs of their semi-final in May 2026.

Saint-Denis won 3-2 at Bruille, who drop to fourth. Thorigné-Fouillard beat Chartres 3-1 on the night (the FFTT's results graphic now lists it as a 3-0 award, without a reason), leaving the promoted side bottom with six defeats from six, and Loups d'Angers beat La Romagne 3-0 in the Maine-et-Loire derby to move level on points with Saint-Denis, who were also promoted.

- Loire Nord TT (Roanne) 3-1 SPO Rouen
- Alliance Nîmes/Montpellier 3-2 GV Hennebont
- Bruille 2-3 TT Saint-Denis
- TFTT Thorigné-Fouillard 3-1 Chartres
- Loups d'Angers 3-0 La Romagne

Pro A awards four points for a win and one point for each match won in a defeat. No team goes down at the end of this season, a transition year before the French federation reforms its professional leagues in 2027-28.

The seventh matchday is on Tuesday. Rouen host Nîmes/Montpellier at the Kindarena (6.30pm UK), and Rouen say the visitors will bring both Lebruns. Hennebont play Bruille, Chartres host Roanne, La Romagne play Thorigné-Fouillard and Saint-Denis host Angers. The table and fixtures are on Eleven's [Pro A page](/clubs/pro-a.html).
